items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: I'd been listening to Ella Fitzgerald and Billie Holiday... I was certainly doing their songs. I often wondered how singers like Billie Holiday and some of the others... managed these one-nighters

ctx.x: You don't think he'd do that?

No, I don't think he'd do; (inaudible), and I don't want to do it either, you know. After Billie, I don't think anybody should sing 'Lover Man.' That's another thing, too. A long time ago when we were all singers were all, you know, looking for that special song to sing, we shied away from singing what was another person's song. they were identified with. And especially -- well, in this particular case, getting back to the female and the male songs, it would be easier for me to sing a song and get by with…
